reason: Retinoids increase sun sensitivity; use them at night and wear sunscreen during the day.
advice: Add a broad-spectrum SPF 30+ sunscreen as the last step of your morning routine.
source: American Academy of Dermatology. Retinoid or retinol? | RETIN-A (tretinoin) prescribing information, Precautions

reason: AHAs can increase sensitivity to the sun; FDA requires a 'Sunburn Alert' and advises sunscreen during use and for a week afterwards.
advice: Add a broad-spectrum SPF 30+ sunscreen as the last step of your morning routine.
source: US FDA. Alpha Hydroxy Acids (cosmetics ingredient page, Sunburn Alert)
